description: Create a source-qualified preparation identity with partial source-supported components. TOGO M202 names 100 mL of 4% Na2CO3-CO2 buffer. The source-defined carbonate/CO2 preparation can be represented without inventing a CO2 saturation protocol. The final medium pH 6.7-6.8 is not assigned to the stock. Direct JCM 209 retrieval was unsuccessful; the captured TOGO recipe is the evidence used. Successor-v2 metadata adds the exact frozen KG ingredient1685/J209 context to this already represented source stock; the original owner payload is unchanged.
identity_predicate_consequences: Local kgmicrobe.ingredient preparation identity with FALLBACK_REGISTRY mapping to its own identifier. No whole-to-constituent mapping, CAS, or exact external ontology equivalence. Registry exactMatch row would identify only this source-qualified preparation.
publication_review_obligations: Proposal only. Full content-bound publication review, integration conflict checks, maintained-surface synchronization and native export QC remain required after acceptance. No roles or complete owner approval.
cross_shard_conflicts: No overlap with the original 36 owner paths. New preparations must be compared against concurrent proposals before integration; similar names alone do not establish same formulation.
publication_holds: The 4% basis, solvent, carbonate hydration and CO2 equilibration conditions are unknown. No numeric component concentration or exact equivalence to another carbonate stock is asserted.
Do not infer a complete formula from PARTIAL components or convert receiving-medium stock additions into mass concentrations.

source_case_applicability.scope: Original case21 TOGO M202/CultureMech008618 occurrence retained unchanged. Its original scientific decision is not revised.
Only the exact admitted row linked through ingredient1685.media[0]=J209 and the same JCM209 provenance in TOGO M202; no invented CM_OCC ID or global alias.

metadata_successor.change_scope: Case/evidence/applicability metadata only; retain original proposal_id and after_capture; select this metadata once, not as a second owner.
metadata_successor.history_rationale: No ingredient identity, composition, label, synonym, source assertion inside the owner, or maintained record changes. The historical TOGO-only authoring note remains truthful; the new MediaDive correspondence belongs to this new dated source-association ledger.
